title: Continuous integral and uniformizer-quotient coefficient rings
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite field extension, with its spectral absolute value, ring of integers $\mathcal O_E$, chosen uniformizer $\pi_E$ and quotient $A_n=\mathcal O_E/(\pi_E^n)$ for $n\in\mathbf N$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Give $\mathcal O_E$ the subspace topology and $A_n$ the quotient topology. By [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring] form the condensed ring sheaves $\underline{\mathcal O_E}:P\mapsto C(P,\mathcal O_E)$ and $\underline{A_n}:P\mapsto C(P,A_n)$. The continuous quotient homomorphism $\mathcal O_E\to A_n$ induces the morphism $\underline{\mathcal O_E}\to\underline{A_n}$ by postcomposition [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]. Their underlying abelian sheaves carry their pointwise commutative ring-object structures [sk-def-sfb-ring-object], and the same postcomposition gives their ring-object morphism. Level $n$ denotes exponent $n$, including the zero quotient for $n=0$.
